title: AI Film Studio — Cinematic Style & Physical Lighting Recipes Library
description: Engineered Prompt-as-Code lighting, optical, compositional, and material recipes for historical cinema and classical visual narrative.

recipe_dramatic_sunset_interior.name: Dramatic Sunset Library Interior

lighting.primary_source: Low-angle warm sunset streaming through high narrow stone aperture
lighting.color_temperature: 3200K golden amber key light, 5600K subtle cool shadow bounce
lighting.contrast_ratio: Medium-high contrast with raking grazing light across surfaces
lighting.atmospheric_scattering: Visible airborne dust motes illuminated in sharp volumetric light beam (Tyndall effect)

optics.optical_character: Subtle oval anamorphic bokeh, gentle highlight halation, organic edge falloff

materials.stone: Porous hand-chiseled limestone ashlar blocks with micro-relief and natural sediment pores
materials.wood: Aged dry cedar wood beams with deep matte grain and hand-carved tool marks
materials.textiles: Unbleached coarse woven linen tunic with visible warp and weft fibers

recipe_dramatic_sunset_interior.negative_locks: digital oversharpening, modern studio softbox, neon colors, plastic surfaces, flat lighting

recipe_night_candlelight_intimacy.name: Night Candlelight & Intimate Contemplation

lighting.primary_source: Single organic beeswax candle flame on cedar table
lighting.contrast_ratio: Deep soft chiaroscuro, readable warm shadows without digital noise
lighting.reflection_physics: Subtle warm specular glint in eye pupils and smooth bronze signet ring

optics.depth_of_field: Shallow depth of field, sharp subject eye focus, soft background decay

materials.skin: Weathered 60-year-old Mediterranean skin with authentic pores, fine wrinkles, textured grey beard
materials.parchment: Ancient dried papyrus/parchment with fibrous frayed edges and dark iron-gall ink

recipe_night_candlelight_intimacy.negative_locks: electric light, modern lamps, cgi glow, plastic skin, beauty retouching

recipe_macro_tactile_parchment.name: Macro Tactile Hands & Ancient Manuscript

lighting.primary_source: Raking side-light from terracotta oil lamp grazing across parchment surface
lighting.contrast_ratio: High tactile relief revealing micro-topography of paper and skin

optics.framing_focus: Subject hands occupy 45-55% of frame, extreme focal plane precision

materials.parchment: Handmade animal parchment with organic drying ripples, faint ink cracks, lead stone weight
materials.hands: Elderly scholar hands with sun spots, natural fingernails, slight skin dryness, no manicure

recipe_macro_tactile_parchment.negative_locks: bound codex book, printed fonts, modern paper, smooth plastic hands, synthetic fibers

recipe_exterior_jerusalem_dawn.name: Exterior Jerusalem Dawn & Roman Garrison

lighting.primary_source: Cold blue pre-dawn skylight (6000K) meeting first horizontal golden sun ray (3800K)
lighting.contrast_ratio: Soft atmospheric perspective with natural morning distance haze over Judean hills

optics.depth_of_field: Deep focus, architectural legibility across all three planes

materials.architecture: Massive Herodian limestone blocks with draft margins, dry packed earth roads, dust
materials.metal: Hammered oxidized Roman iron and weathered bronze armor without chrome sheen

recipe_exterior_jerusalem_dawn.negative_locks: byzantine domes, gothic arches, modern asphalt, medieval castle, fantasy landscapes

recipe_classical_narrative_timeline.name: Classical Narrative Timeline & Historical Infographic

composition_layers.layer_1_foreground: Seated historical thinkers/characters in deep dialogue occupying lower 40% of frame, detailed hand gestures, papyrus scrolls
composition_layers.layer_2_midground: Ascending luminous golden timeline path rising like a constellation from foreground up to distant cityscape
composition_layers.layer_3_background: Ancient sunlit acropolis, stone colonnades, and aged sky overlay with architectural blueprints and manuscript calligraphy

lighting.primary_source: Warm Mediterranean late afternoon sun (3200K) casting gentle directional shadows
lighting.contrast_ratio: Rich chiaroscuro with warm golden rim lighting on garments and stone surfaces

optics.optical_character: Sharp optical focus on foreground figures, soft atmospheric decay toward distant hills

materials.stone: Sun-bleached classical limestone pillars with authentic chiseled inscriptions and natural weathering
materials.textiles: Heavy drape linen himations and unbleached chitons with natural fiber weave
materials.parchment: Ancient dried papyrus scrolls and calligraphic manuscript fragments

recipe_classical_narrative_timeline.negative_locks: modern clothing, bound books, plastic skin, CGI neon overload, split-screen collage, distorted typography
